request: Isolate FFmpeg Alpine package installation failure using existing Node image, no log disclosure or service mutation

bounded_host_request.command: sh -c 'command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 70; docker image inspect node:22-alpine >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 71; f="$(mktemp)" || exit 72; trap "rm -f \"$f\"" EXIT; if docker run --rm --pull never node:22-alpine sh -c "apk add --no-cache ffmpeg" >"$f" 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; if grep -Eiq "temporary error|try again later|could not resolve|bad address|network unreachable|connection refused|timed out|timeout|TLS|SSL|certificate" "$f"; then exit 81; fi; if grep -Eiq "unable to select packages|no such package|unsatisfiable constraints" "$f"; then exit 82; fi; if grep -Eiq "permission denied|operation not permitted|access denied" "$f"; then exit 83; fi; if grep -Eiq "no space left|disk quota|out of space" "$f"; then exit 84; fi; if grep -Eiq "failed to create|cannot connect to the Docker daemon|OCI runtime" "$f"; then exit 85; fi; exit 86'
